name: landing-page
title: Landing page
description: A product landing page made only with mangacn, for an invented manga publishing app: a top nav that folds into a Sheet below 42rem of container width, an opening splash page of Panels on a PanelGrid (lettering headline, focus SpeedLines and an accent Burst around the cover you pass, never under text, a shout Button and an outline Button, an ink panel of key figures; three columns with a slanted gutter from 48rem), features in cases (ink-case), pricing as a VersusPanel (Free vs Pro, Pro highlighted, monthly or yearly with pressed buttons in a Button Group), reviews in SpeechBubbles with square Avatars, a FAQ in the Accordion and a footer with link columns and a newsletter InputGroup in a Field that validates the address. One column on phones, container queries widen it; links never navigate. Works in light, dark, any accent and at phone width.
docs: Import from "@/components/manga/blocks/landing-page". The root fills its container and follows the page (no inner scroll). The layout reacts to the width of the block itself (container queries), so it also works inside a narrower frame. The FAQ Accordion gets type="multiple" through a loosely typed spread (FAQ_MODE): Radix requires it, Base UI ignores it, so the file works with both. Pass the opening panel's cover as an image URL in cover; the block ships none (a screentone cover without it).

meta.tagline: An opening page, features in panels, pricing as a versus, reviews in bubbles.

props.name: cover
props.description: Image URL or node of the cover in the opening panel. Without it, a screentone cover.

props.name: className
props.description: Size and placement of the whole interface.

props.name: titleAs
props.description: The title's heading level: "h1" when the block is the page, "h2" inside a page that already has its h1.
